note: Blind off-catalogue geothermal propensity (dilation+TC+gravity+basement); dots off mapped faults. Format-valid; see run card.

format.validation_class: local format/range preflight; not organizer acceptance or uniqueness clearance

method.hypothesis: Blind / off-catalogue geothermal faults (missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue) express as localized geodetic dilatation, radiometric total-count alteration, gravity density-contrast boundaries and deep sedimentary cover; they are NOT close to mapped traces, so a catalogue-driven surface is the wrong target.
method.mechanism: Rank-normalize geod_dilaterate, tc (GeoDAWN Total Count), iso_grav_anom, iso_grav_anom_slope, depth_to_base_surf, ieq_n100a15 over the footprint; average with fixed weights; remove a 3 px collar around mapped faults; emit one dot per 5x5 px tile ranked by triangular-kernel expected credit.
layers: training_features.tif bands 6, 5, 8, 13, 15, 17; existing_faults.tif catalogue; sample_submission.tif footprint
method.physical_signature: geodetic dilatation + radiometric alteration + gravity boundary + deep basement
method.why_off_catalogue: Catalogue traces are masked from scoring; new geothermal faults are expected blind/off-catalogue. Distance-to-visible-fault cannot discover them.
method.differs_from_repo: Every GEMSDOE86 lane uses distance-to-catalogue / tip continuation / snap-to-catalogue as its primary driver; this lane uses none of them.
method.non_fault_mimic: Shallow alluvial/radionuclide or sedimentation patterns can elevate TC and basement depth without a fault (leakage canary: no truth fit, so no leakage).

uniqueness.scope_note: Checked against every registry raster whose bytes are present locally (plus any explicitly fetched witnesses). Un-fetched registry entries are a stated scope limitation, never a claim of absence.

literal_reading.note: Keeps the inherited literal support definition. A continuous-surface prior fires on every nonempty candidate, so a firing here is not evidence of duplication; it is reported for completeness.

like_for_like_reading.note: Inherited thresholds, applied to dot fields only; rank correlation still applies to every raster including the continuous surfaces.

verdict: format-valid; not organizer-confirmed; weekly slot not used
registry_scoped: Locally present registry rasters only (docs/downloads); not organizer-complete.
validation_class: LOCAL-FORMAT-VALIDATION and archived lane receipt; not organizer acceptance
